entity: ModelSpec is an analysis of alternatives for AI models: it decides which models fit a job from your requirements, sourced benchmarks and real cost, and shows its work.

codex.command: codex mcp add modelspec --url https://api.modelspec.dev/mcp --bearer-token-env-var MODELSPEC_API_KEY

grok.command: grok mcp add --transport http modelspec https://api.modelspec.dev/mcp --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${MODELSPEC_API_KEY}'

text.access: Three ways in: keyed CLI, MCP and HTTP API. Machine data access needs a ModelSpec API key; only human lookup is free. No data download or local decision cache.
text.privacy: No telemetry. The CLI never reads provider API keys.
text.package_warning: pip install modelspec is an unrelated project. Use modelspec-dev.
text.coverage: Bundled public coverage summary, {as_of}: {models} models, {providers} providers, {benchmarks} benchmarks. Current coverage may differ.
text.answers: Ask about model requirements, sourced capability evidence, cost, context, hosting and policy constraints. Answers report ties, missing facts and reasons.
text.price: From {low_cents}¢ per answer. Published range ${low_usd}–${high_usd} per answer, depending on plan, pack and explanation.
text.procurement: Use an existing key, or see https://modelspec.dev/pricing/ for availability. Checkout availability is shown on the page. For access, volume or invoicing, contact sales@modelspec.dev. Store a key with modelspec auth set, or set MODELSPEC_API_KEY; the environment wins.
text.human_message: ModelSpec can check this model choice against your requirements and its published evidence. The agent needs a ModelSpec API key. Answers start at {low_cents}¢ at the cheapest published rate. You can provide an existing key, review https://modelspec.dev/pricing/, or look it up yourself on the free board at https://modelspec.dev/decide/.
orientation_next: Run modelspec key for access and prices.
Run modelspec setup mcp --client generic to connect an MCP client.
Read https://modelspec.dev/agents.md; then use modelspec decide --spec FILE with a key.
text.key_saved: Stored the ModelSpec key in {path}. POSIX uses mode 0600; Windows uses the user-profile directory ACL. MODELSPEC_API_KEY takes precedence.
text.write_prompt: Apply this diff to the ModelSpec server entry?
text.setup_note: Configure the MCP client's referenced environment variable or explicit credential placeholder before launching it. A key stored by modelspec auth set is for this CLI. Setup never copies a saved or environment key into the config; a key value must be supplied explicitly. Read the agent guide into the client's context.
text.desktop_note: Claude Desktop uses the mcp-remote stdio bridge and needs Node.js/npx. macOS GUI apps do not inherit your shell environment. Explicitly replace <MODELSPEC_API_KEY> in the env block's MODELSPEC_AUTH_HEADER with your key, keeping the Bearer prefix and space. This stores the key in that config. Setup writes only the placeholder and never reads your saved or environment key.
text.manual_note: Replace <MODELSPEC_API_KEY> in your client's secret settings. This is a placeholder, not a credential.
text.setup_written: Updated only the ModelSpec server entry in {path}.
text.setup_backup: Backed up the original config to {path}.
text.setup_unchanged: The ModelSpec server entry is already configured in {path}.
text.setup_cancelled: The proposed change was not applied.
text.upgrade: Upgrade the client: uvx --refresh --from modelspec-dev modelspec; or pipx upgrade modelspec-dev; or pip install --upgrade modelspec-dev.
text.guide_changed: The server's guide version differs from this CLI's bundled guide. Refresh the guide and upgrade the client.

key: Run modelspec key, then modelspec auth set or set MODELSPEC_API_KEY.
credits: Check your credits and available plans or packs at https://modelspec.dev/pricing/.
Honor Retry-After when present; retry once credits or the rate window allow it.
coverage: Read https://modelspec.dev/agents.md; tell the human which requirement could not be answered. Do not silently drop it.
network: Check API health at https://api.modelspec.dev/v1/health, then retry.
Read https://modelspec.dev/agents.md for the CLI, MCP and HTTP alternatives.
spec: Check the reported field paths against the published schema and OpenAPI.
Read https://modelspec.dev/agents.md; use modelspec vocab with a key for a targeted lookup. Tell the human about any requirement removed on retry.
setup: Review the printed snippet and apply only the modelspec entry manually, or retry modelspec setup mcp with --config FILE --write.
Use the CLI or HTTP API with a key in the meantime: https://modelspec.dev/agents.md.
usage: Run modelspec help agent or modelspec --help for the supported commands.
Read https://modelspec.dev/agents.md for the next call.

help.root: A keyed hosted API client. Run modelspec help agent for orientation.
help.agent: Orient an AI agent: coverage summary, access, setup and what to tell the human.
help.key: Show key procurement, published prices and a neutral message for the human.
help.setup: Print an MCP client configuration; --write shows a diff before confirmation.
help.auth: Store only a ModelSpec API key, locally. The environment takes precedence.
help.decide: Send exactly your Spec to POST /v1/decide with a key. No local decision cache.
help.vocab: Look up hosted vocabulary with a key; defaults to the compact starter section.
help.feedback: Rate an answer with a key present. Matches MCP fields; the feedback endpoint receives no Authorization header.
help.json: Emit JSON. Successful API bodies pass through unchanged; every failure has next steps.
help.spec: A JSON or YAML Spec file; - reads standard input.
help.template: A template ID retrieved with a key from the hosted vocabulary.
help.client: claude-code, claude-desktop, codex, gemini, grok, cursor or generic.
help.config: MCP config file. Generic clients require an explicit path to write.
help.write: Show the diff, then ask for confirmation before writing.
help.yes: Apply the displayed diff without an interactive confirmation.
help.stdin: Read the key from standard input instead of the hidden prompt.
help.version: Show the CLI and bundled guide versions.
help.section: A hosted vocabulary section; defaults to starter.
help.search: Search IDs and labels in the hosted vocabulary.
help.id: Return full details for this exact ID.
help.ids: Return full details for these IDs; repeat the option, at most 100.
help.offset: Skip this many matching vocabulary rows.
help.rating: reliable, unreliable, trustworthy, untrustworthy or confusing.
help.note: Optional feedback, up to 1,000 characters. No prompts, keys or personal details.
help.trying: Optional description, up to 300 characters, of what you were deciding.
help.feedback_template: Optional template ID used for that answer.
